existing.description: The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship is the University of Toronto's most prestigious award for international students and one of the largest scholarship programmes for international students in Canada. It covers tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years and is tenable only at the University of Toronto for first-entry undergraduate programmes. Around 37 scholars are named each year from a pool representing 188 countries, with more than CAD 12 million of funding in 2024. Candidates must be nominated by their secondary school, which can nominate only one student per year, and must also apply for admission to the University of Toronto through the Ontario Universities' Application Centre. The scholarship is restricted to the applicant's top-choice programme at the time scholarship decisions are made.
existing.eligibility_summary: International student applying to UofT, exceptional academic achievement and leadership, community involvement
requirements: Be an international student, meaning a non-Canadian who requires a study permit
Be enrolled in the final year of senior secondary school in 2026/2027, or have graduated no earlier than June 2026
Begin studies at the University of Toronto in September 2027
Be nominated by your secondary school, which may nominate only one student per year
Apply for admission to at least one undergraduate programme at the University of Toronto through the OUAC
Complete the Pearson Scholarship application sent to you after nomination
Not use generative AI tools to create any content in the application
application_method: Ask your guidance counsellor, principal or head of school whether the school is verified to participate
School submits the nomination form by October 9, 2026
Submit an OUAC application for undergraduate admission by October 16, 2026
Use the private Pearson Scholarship application link received after nomination
Submit the scholarship application and all documentation by November 6, 2026
existing.selection_notes: Pearson Scholars are selected for exceptional academic achievement, creativity and leadership potential. Recipients are notified starting at the end of January and all nominees are notified by April. The university publishes a fraud alert: the programme does not work with recruitment agents, and recipients can only be nominated by their current secondary school through the online process.
existing.best_fit: Outstanding high school graduates targeting University of Toronto
existing.notes: Must apply to UofT undergraduate program first. School nomination may be required.
existing.duration: Four years of full-time undergraduate study
existing.application_period: Annual for September entry. For the 2027 intake: nomination forms available from July 6, 2026, school nomination by October 9, 2026, OUAC application by October 16, 2026, scholarship application by November 6, 2026.
existing.deadline_display: Typically November — must apply to UofT first
